summary: ep01 finalised shot list: 101 shots in 37 generation groups, 542.0 s against the 540 s episode_plan budget (+0.37%). Every shot carries final duration, size, camera position, content, the screenplay action/dialogue line it realises, characters / creatures / costumes / props, is_dialogue with inline dialogue_lines, view_tile and poses. Every group carries scene_no / scene_id, integer total_duration_s, time_of_day + lighting_scheme_id, characters_union / creatures_union / costumes_by_char, has_dialogue, audio_plan, continuity_from, scene_refs and blocking_map, and the six director transitions are re-hung on the final boundaries. narration_anchors is absent by design (narration off project-wide). audio_plan.rule_applied: Narration is off project-wide (settings.json output.narration_enabled=false), so narration_anchors is omitted entirely and narration_over is never used. Every group is dialogue (has a spoken line) or ambient_only (does not).
audio_plan.silent_rationale: All 13 ambient_only groups carry their own silent_rationale. Every one of them is silent by the director's design rather than by omission: the hook head (a promise, not an explanation), the rabbit's pass and her run-off (reaction only, and the sister must not answer), the chase and the drain to silence at the burrow (the silence IS the dream's front door), the unbroken fall-asleep take (the onset must not be announced), the whole of S05 (62 s of architecture argument, the longest dialogue-free stretch in the episode by design, plus the silently played garden beat per the screenplay adaptation_note), the three failed climbs (a physical defeat that must not become complaint, protecting the scolding close-up two groups later), the key-and-one-eye pair, and the two splashes before the plunge. Nothing was routed to narration and nothing needed to be.
audio_plan.no_group_needs_help: No ambient_only group was found that cannot carry its story in pictures, so nothing was escalated to orchestrator on this account.

deviations.item: The hook head shot sh001 / grp001 runs 4.0 s, not the 3 s the user signed at H3S.
deviations.why: The gate ruling names 'oh-1 (opening, 3s flash-forward of the slow well-fall)'. A 3 s group cannot be produced: code/check_generation_groups.py enforces a 4 s floor on total_duration_s (MIN_GROUP_S), which is the video model's minimum clip length, and this shot is a group of one with nothing to merge it into. Merging it into grp002 is impossible — different scene_id, and it is the narrative_block entry.
deviations.decided: Extended to 4.0 s. The design is untouched: same locked wide, same framing, same content; it simply holds one second longer. Episode total 542.0 s, still +0.37% of budget.
deviations.if_the_user_disagrees: The only alternatives are dropping the hook (which reverses their ruling) or changing the project's video model to one with a shorter minimum clip. Both are user decisions, not mine. Routed to orchestrator for disclosure; no rework is needed either way unless the user rules otherwise.

deviations.item: Group totals are integers, contrary to the work order's note that 'integer seconds are not required'.
deviations.why: The host check the same work order told me to run enforces isinstance(total_duration_s, int) alongside the [4, max_group_s] range; the 30 s cap from the user's video-model setting supersedes the 15 s ceiling but not the integer rule. Leaving the storyboard's 15.5 / 12.5 / 24.5 totals would have failed the check outright.
deviations.decided: Thirteen single shots nudged by 0.5-1.0 s (table above). Per-shot durations still use 0.5 s steps; only group totals are integers. No boundary, beat or line moved.

deviations.why: That CLI has no --project/--ep options. Documented above under machine_checks; the check itself is the one the work order asked for.

deviations.item: Four transition_in intents and one narrative_block kind were remapped to the host's controlled enums.
deviations.why: The storyboard wrote descriptive intents (start_on_picture, register_jolt, unannounced_dream_onset, time_ellipsis, sleep_onset, plunge_impact) and kind 'flashforward', none of which are in code/check_generation_groups.py's TRANSITION_INTENTS / BLOCK_KINDS.
deviations.decided: TR-01 -> episode_open, TR-02 -> flashback_out, TR-03 -> dream_in, TR-04 -> time_skip, TR-05 -> other, TR-06 -> scene_change; FF-ep01-open kind -> flashback. Every one carries an intent_note / kind_note stating the original word and, for FF-ep01-open, warning downstream that the block is a flash-FORWARD and the direction must be read from the id and the note, not from kind. No reason text was altered and no transition was added or dropped.

problems_found_not_fixed.id: FF-ep01-open kind has no correct enum value
problems_found_not_fixed.detail: The episode's head block is a flash-forward. BLOCK_KINDS is (flashback, dream, montage, imagination) and has no flashforward member, so the block is filed as 'flashback' with a kind_note. Any downstream tool that reads kind literally will have the time direction backwards. Not patched here — the fix belongs in the host enum, not in project data.
problems_found_not_fixed.mitigation_in_place: grp001.narrative_block.kind_note spells out the real direction, and the block id FF-ep01-open is self-describing.

problems_found_not_fixed.routed_to: already open, raised by the director and routed to memory-bible
problems_found_not_fixed.detail: color_script's scene_curves describe daylight through high halo-roundel windows in the hall and a daylight shaft in the pool; architecture.json says the hall is windowless with blind roundels and lighting.json rules roundel_glow: reflected_lamplight_only. The director's interim direction is followed literally in every S05-S10 shot here: no daylight, no roundel shaft, no cast coloured light in the hall except the garden green through the little door, and in S10 the way-out light is the brightest reflection field at the south end. If memory-bible rules the other way, S05/S06/S10 need a lighting re-pass but NO re-cut and no change to this shot list.

The S08 action line gives the Rabbit gloves in one hand and a fan in the other while trotting. The user ruled at H3S that the mouth-carry staging stands and the screenplay stays frozen. Staged accordingly in sh073/sh074/sh077 and recorded in grp028's quadruped_note. No further action.

The storyboard flagged S03 at 9 shots / ASL 5.3 s against the plan's ~6 / ~8 s, and handed the final numbers to me. Reviewed and kept: both POV-straight-down inserts are separately required by the plan's seven-POV list, the three dressing passes must read as distinct, and TR-04 / TR-05 need boundaries to hang on. S03 finalises at 9 shots / 48.0 s / ASL 5.3 s, on its pacing allocation of 48.0 s. No change.

grp031 is 30 s — exactly the project's group cap — and runs 0.66 dialogue density. It cannot be lengthened. Any future growth in LN-024 / LN-025 / LN-026 must be solved by trimming the text. Recorded in the group's group_integrity field.

handoff.camera-movement / composition / blocking: Shot ids, durations, sizes and camera_position are frozen. Each shot also carries a 'constraint' field holding the director instructions that are not mine to relitigate (locked frames, unbroken takes, the single up-angle, the one two-step tilt, distance discipline on the Rabbit, the camera that does not follow). blocking must put every per-shot station on the group's blocking_map line and may not contradict route_en.
handoff.continuity-planning: Three live risks unchanged from the storyboard: Alice's four size states inside one room (1.35 / 0.254 / 2.74 / 0.61 m, gauged against 0.715 / 1.95 / 2.30 / 2.80 / 0.38 m, written on the shots' and groups' scale_note fields); the water level ratcheting from nothing in S07 to four inches in S08 to swimmable in S10, which must never reset; and the Rabbit's prop ledger ending with one glove on Alice's hand and the fan drifting past her in S10. One boundary needs boundary_cast_framing attention: grp027 -> grp028, where the White Rabbit joins the cast — mitigated by opening grp028 on Alice alone and having him enter from the far dark end on a different axis; the note is in grp028.boundary_cast_note.
handoff.08-video-gen/prompt: Quadruped corrective wording is mandatory in grp011, grp012, grp028, grp029 (quadruped_note on each). audio_plan is the hard input for the no-dialogue constraint on all 13 ambient_only groups. time_of_day + lighting_scheme_id are the only legitimate source for light description. Do not write inter-group transitions into any video_prompt.
handoff.09-edit/transition: Six entries; two are renderable (grp009 dissolve 0.6 s, grp010 dissolve 0.8 s), four are annotation-only and render as hard cuts. Sigma renderable 1.4 s, inside the 1% budget. The tail to black plus one splash over black after sh101 is the edit's tail, is not a group and carries no transition_in.
handoff.long_take_off: settings.duration.long_take = false, so group_transitions anchor is always none. continuity_from in this file is an ordering pointer demanded by the host check and must NOT be read as a tail-frame anchor; a top-level note in shot_list.json says so.
